answer: Each agent earns a reputation ember that ages with every block it validates; the ledger stores a time‑locked stake proportional to that age, released only after a lagoon‑length cooldown. When a new identity appears, it starts at the nadir with zero stake and must lock the full entry fee, which equals the cumulative reputation of a mature node, typically 10 000 PoA tokens, before any credit is granted. An attacker therefore must pre‑pay and idle 30 days per fake identity, making large‑scale Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive.
